read: Background, CDR-confounding results, Methods single-cell RNA-seq hurdle model and regularization sections. Publisher accessible; PMC browser challenge blocked direct retrieval.
mechanism: Paper uses logistic detection and Gaussian positive expression, bayesglm weak priors and CDR covariate. Own adaptation uses latent flow covariates, deterministic L2-ridge logistic optimization and existing donor-relative positive heads; no MAST inference/CDR/Bayesian reproduction or temporal guarantee.
